messages:
incident-bot: AUTOMATED ALERT — P1: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (us-west) · 3890004321
incident-bot: Summary: 5xx rate spiked to ~12% over 3m, error mix: 429 upstream -> 502/504 cascading. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/3890004321 · page sent to #incidents and oncall
alex: seeing a huge spike in gateway 5xx and a lot of 429s originating from rate-limiter responses. sample log: `rate_limit_exceeded tenant=acct-42 window_ms=50 limit=100` then backend 502 from model-worker pool
maria: i'm oncall — looking at traces now. are those 429s client-side or upstream? what customers hit first?
sam: Customer-A (dedicated) reported timeouts ~08:16-08:20 UTC, we see 504s from model-router -> model-worker 502s shortly after. suspect rate-limit/quota change yesterday.
priya: i deployed a rate-limiter config tweak at 02:40 UTC that reduced burst window (intended to smooth cost) — rolling back to previous values now. running: ```kubectl -n infra set env deploy/rate-limiter RATE_WINDOW_MS=2000 --record``` will also restart pods gracefully
alex: also seeing model-pool-3 queue depth jump to 3k requests. if we don't shed load we keep getting 502s. can we enable smaller-model fallback for non-enterprise traffic to lower memory pressure?
priya: enabling fallback routing for non-enterprise tenants: ```/api/v1/route-config set fallback_model=gpt-small if tenant_tier!=enterprise``` deploying rule now
incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollback job initiated by priya at 3890004380 — job id rb-3890004380 (status: in_progress)
ira: queue drain suggested. also propose temporary short-circuit for large seq requests: reject requests with tokens>1024 at edge with 429 to protect workers. Priya can you add that rule?
priya: added token-length guard to edge-limiter: ```policy: { "max_tokens":1024, "action":"reject", "code":429, "reason":"protect_workers" }``` live in edge-config at 3890004412
maria: paging jordan for escalation and quota service deep-dive (jordan oncall PD). Jordan please jump in and confirm if quota counters reset anywhere. @jordan
jordan: i'm in. checking quota service — noticed a cache invalidation job that ran at 02:39 UTC which appears to zero counters briefly then reapply allowances. that allowed a bursty window where many tokens were considered available. i'm applying a fix to make invalidation transactional. also bumping soft-quota for enterprise account acct-42 to avoid automated throttles while we stabilize. applying patch now.
alex: customer impact snapshot: Customer-A (acct-42) degraded 08:16-08:22, Customer-B intermittent 429s but auto-retries succeeded, ~7% of requests retried. showing decline after rollback and token guard.
sam: rollback status: deploy-bot shows rb-3890004380 succeeded at 3890004440. metrics: 5xx rate fell from 14% -> 4% within 6 minutes. link: https://grafana.redwood/d/xyz/5xx-over-time
maria: great. keep the fallback and token guard in place for 30m while we monitor. Jordan, we'll need a follow-up to fix cache invalidation logic in quota service and add a canary for window changes.
jordan: noted — will open a follow-up ticket and schedule a patch with runtime team. also will add a Prometheus alert for sudden drops in quota counter values.
priya: rollback fully completed and fallbacks applied, deploy-bot status success at 3890004440. monitoring hooks added to console for token-guard events.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated — error rates returned to baseline at 3890004460. continued monitoring and RCA required.
maria: thanks everyone — I'll draft a short customer comms (internal copy) and hand off to postmortem. Oncall handover: @jordan you're primary. If anything re-spikes, page infra runtime. Closing incident thread for live mitigation; keep updates here for RCA notes.
